housing.text: Her campaign agenda calls for building more affordable housing and lowering barriers to homeownership.
housing.quote: Lower the barriers to buying a home, build more affordable housing, and address the cost of living.

schools.text: She supports directing education funding to students and letting families choose among public, charter, private, and homeschool options.
schools.quote: Families should be empowered to choose the best learning environment for their children, whether that is a public school, charter school, private school, or homeschool.

safety.text: Her campaign agenda says she supports law enforcement and addressing crime to make communities safer.
safety.quote: Support law enforcement, address crime, and make communities safer.

immigration.text: She supports border enforcement and removal of some immigrants, while also supporting an earned path to citizenship and a lawful process for some people to remain.
immigration.quote: I support securing our southern border, enforcing our immigration laws, and prioritizing the removal of criminals and those who pose a threat to public safety. At the same time, we should create a clear, lawful process for people who have earned the right to remain

immigration.text: He supports citizenship pathways and protections for Dreamers, TPS holders, and other immigrants, along with orderly border management.
immigration.quote: I support: - A roadmap to citizenship for Dreamers, TPS holders, and the immigrants whose labor keeps our economy running; - Permanently protecting TPS and DACA;

health.text: He supports a pathway to make health care a right and says he would strengthen the Affordable Care Act and defend Medicare and Medicaid.
health.quote: In Congress, Oliver will fight for a pathway to ensure that healthcare is a right for every American.
